best.why: Phone dies mid-navigation: overall-direction-in-head vs read-the-signs-in-front is the textbook Ni-Se split, a realistic mishap with no one to blame, equal lengths and equally mild costs
Using AI output as-is vs reworking it until it feels mine separates Te goal-completion from Fi authenticity in a fresh, topical scene, and the costs (style vs time) are equal in weight
AI prompting: trying many framings vs the way that has worked; both sides are sensible, costs mirror each other, and the scene is new to the bank
Follows the Thai research recommendation directly: a close-friend setting where honest coherence-checking and supportive answering each carry a real cost, so neither reads as the 'bad friend'
The read-receipt scene captures Fe attunement (how the other person will feel about what they see) with a concrete, self-limiting cost; very Thai-real and not a 'nice person' answer
Live-selling scene: attention goes to the seller stretching and lighting the product, not the description; pure Se, very current in Thai shopping, no ability or virtue wording
Spotting that 'lighter and more durable than every model' do not go together is pure Ti contradiction-detection, kept internal and about ideas, which the Thai research says is necessary
An out-of-stock mishap makes Ni ask what it deeply wants from the item, leading to a different category; captures convergence on the underlying need with a neutral, believable outcome
Choosing detergent by the remembered scent that makes the room feel like home is Si sensory memory in a tiny everyday decision; warm but not virtuous, and new to the bank
Putting an item back when a friend looks unimpressed, while still liking it inside, shows Fe yielding to others' reactions without heroism; the inner-preference cost keeps it neutral
